page.overview:
What is Iron Crown?

Iron Crown is an armored turquoise Pokémon resembling Cobalion. The eyes are bright digital blue and the top of it's luminous head has two yellow metal horns similar in shape to drills, with luminous patches extending from the upper half of the horn. It has a gray metal snout and a luminous blaze running from its nose to the back of its head which also has a headpiece with a circle connected by two rectangle pieces.

On its long neck and hind legs, there are small luminous spots. Several other luminous patches on its body, emitted a faint blue aura. Iron Crown's face, parts of its neck, and underside are grey. The grey parts of its body have several dark grey lines connecting to different parts. On its shoulder blades are yellow metal protrusions that resemble fins. Iron Crown's legs are connected by four-leg armor parts with the lower legs having a luminous v-shape brand connecting to light armor and metal hooves.

Although the exact biological origin of this creature is not totally understood, it is widely believed that Iron Crown is a futuristic, robotic form of Cobalion that has taken a far more aggressive role in the way that it interacts with its environment, having a more rigid stance in its form with a more calculated, mechanical sense of mind with how it approaches others.

It is known that these monsters are extremely ruthless creatures that act like living weapons, launching shining energy blades from their horns to slice apart everything surrounding them with little care, much unlike the calmer disposition of modern Cobalion.
